description: This file contains unit tests for the PolicyErrorResponseAdapter class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests the conversion between Adaptable objects and PolicyErrorResponse instances, verifying correct handling of error responses in a protocol adapter context.

classes.name: PolicyErrorResponseAdapterTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PolicyErrorResponseAdapter, implementing test cases for conversion methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, creating an instance of PolicyErrorResponseAdapter and a sample DittoRuntimeException.

methods.name: testFromAdaptable
methods.description: Tests the conversion of an Adaptable object to a PolicyErrorResponse, verifying external headers are preserved.

methods.name: testToAdaptable
methods.description: Tests the conversion of a PolicyErrorResponse back to an Adaptable object, ensuring payload and headers are correctly reconstructed.
